This matchup can be a bit tricky if the Aatrox is good at comboing. Try to play around his cooldowns and trade
when his q is on cd. Keep in mind that this only works early levels, when Aatrox reaches lvl7 his q is basically 0 cd
so try to not E in unless you're going for an all in. Dodge his 3rd Q with R. Good spacing is very important in this mu

Lane is winnable but you are gonna have a hard time if the Akali is somewhat good.
Go second wind and start Dorans shield for the sustain. You win all ins early since her Q has a high energy cost. If you're
even at lvl6 she wins, be careful of all ins

Will update this list fully soonish, there has been a lot of changes and some matchups has
changed since last time - Kryze 20Feb 2023
Update in progress - Kryze 10Dec 2023

You lose early but hard win after first item if you land E, play safe early with short trades only and dorans shield
start. If you can hit your E in lane phase the trade will almost always be won, but don't overextend it unless you
have kill potential. Be patient for your jungle and farm up meanwhile.

Trade with your passive. You will most likely not be able to kill him in lane, and he wont be able to kill you as long as
you dodge his Q and respect his R. Farm up in lane and you should slowly outscale, in late just spam Q2 on him.

Hard matchup since he can ghost you down very easily through entire lane phase, be very careful with your E usage
You start losing hard at lvl6, if you're not ahead at that point you need to play really careful, especially if he has ghost.
His E can cancel your E if he times it correctly. Try to scale for 1 or 2 items, you outscale him in midgame/lategame,
but fights can still be hard. Extended trades = instalose

Chunk with Q2 and do short trades. Care to not use your E carelessly because he
can run you down if you're too far up. Farm up in lane and outscale him later on.

Whole matchup depends on her vital position and if she gets her W off on your E.
Try to mindgame her with your E by E'ing the wall but not using the dash, she will 99% W it unless you're too far.
2nd option is to stay close to a wall and do a fast E so she cant react to it, can end badly
though. In lane try to trade with passive and do short trades. Late is winnable if you play
it slow by kiting and chunking her with Q2. IF SHE PARRYS YOUR E YOU INSTALOSE. (If the stun hits)
Ignite/tp is very good in this matchup, but if you want to play safe you should go flash/tp.

No/Yes if you
play it correctly.

Dorans shield with second wind is your best friend here, start dorans shield and spam W on him.
Grasp is probably the best option but if you wanna play aggressive conq might be a good.
If you get hit by too many barrels you will lose, you need to play around them and focus a lot on dodging them.
Gangplank is very weak early these days so try to punish him a lot and go in with E every opportunity you get.

Your shield should make you win the trades early, try not to trade too hard when it's down.
Only chance he has of winning this matchup is if you don't respect his lvl6, especially if he's running ignite.
You win all short trades and you should win all ins once you have your sunderer.

E wall > wait for his jump > dash on him. It's basically the entire matchup. Going Approach velocity is also good
since you can W then run at him forcing him to E or get chunked. His E has a really long cooldown that you can
punish very hard. Only problem in this matchup his when he is mega form, or when he has tabi and can kite you.
If you miss E he has a lot of room to run you down so be careful, be smart with your E usage.

Decent matchup. He has perma push entire lane phase, lane is a bit annoying since it's very hard for you to
trade with him. But keep farming the minions you can and scale up, lane is winnable later on
if you outplay him by dodging his stun by dodging or pressing R on him. Asking for jungle help is
probably best option in this matchup since at 6 he will just die on gank. I think Heimer top is not that good atm so
should't be too much of an issue.

Try to either dodge her E or R with your R. If she hits most of the E's you will just slowly
die and be forced to back a lot. If you dodge her E it's your turn to trade so feel free to insta E in and chunk her.
Long story short: Dodge her E = win. No dodge = Lose.

In most cases a pretty easy matchup, unless the Irelia is good. You win every 1v1 when there
are no minions nearby as long as you dodge either her E or her R with your R because
she will not have full stacks. Respect her early all in when she has full stacks and just outscale
her really hard after 2 items. Ignite/TP is good here and opens up a lot of kill potential.
Honestly if Irelia is good this matchup can become very hard and very snowbally.

This matchup is really hard to explain since it's all about experience. It favours Jax a lot but
its still winnable since early its lowkey skill matchup matchup. In lane try poke with Q and W (only short trades).
Save E until he jumps on you to knock him back or when you have window for a good trade close to your turret.
(Always be close to a wall in this matchup, since otherwise he can cancel your E with his stun.)Try to trade when
your passive is up. You need to play around his E or lane will be really really rough.

Go second wind and dorans shield if you want to play safe, dorans blade if you want to play
aggro. Lane is Jayce favoured early but once you get 1-2 items you should destroy him. If you're even at that point
it should be free 1v1s. Don't take too much poke in lane, play with bushes or behind minions to avoid his Q poke.

Regarding K'santes current state (13.24) I think this matchup is a lot better than what it used to be. K'santes early is
kinda weak atm so you should look to abuse and trade as much as possible. Trying to find him early in river/tribush
at like 1:20 can be a big deal for lane, start E and jump on him and keep autoing until he runs away.
You can start either dorans shield or blade, both are good options. Blade is better to bully early but more risky since
you might end up doing some bad trades. Before 6 you can play as aggressive as you want, when he hits 6 you
have to respect and not use E carelessly. Once you get sunderer lane will become way easier, spam Q2 on him
whenever possible and be …

PTA/Conq is really good here because you can bully her a lot early. Play really aggro and go in with
E whenever you can. When she hits 6 you need to play carefully and make sure your E will hit or else you'll get
poked a lot. Using W first and then E makes it impossible to dodge your E.
Only chance she wins this lane is if you let her freeze close to her turret. You should try to keep the wave in the
middle of the lane or frozen close to your turret to deny her all xp. At 16 she is stronger unless you're very ahead
and get the jump on her first.

Similar to the jayce matchup, you hard outscale but lane can be rough if you let him poke you.
Slowing him with W makes it very easy to hit E since he can't run away from it, try to chunk
him like that and you will slowly win the lane. Approach velocity is good here.

In general an easy matchup, you win 1v1 through all stages of the game if you play it correctly.
Early becomes really easy if you use your passive correctly and only trade when it's up.
You hard outscale him however lane can become rough if he gets an early kill since Kled relies a lot on snowballing
Once you get sunderer you should stomp him. (Sunderer will be removed in season 14 but I don't think matchup will
change, just go trinity instead)

Killable early but when he gets to lvl>5-6 it becomes really difficult since he's most likely stacking
armor. He's also really hard to duel because of his insane base dmgs. Doing short trades with grasp is good, make
use of your passive whenever it's up and just farm up. Most Malphites will play very safe and make the lane a farm
lane, don't worry too much about it since you'll destroy him once you have sunderer. Second wind and dorans
shield is very nice to deny some of his q spam.
Honestly haven't seen a Maokai top since s9 so I can't say much, but just rush divine sunderer and oneshot him.

Killable very early (lvl2-3) and then he literally becomes an immortal god that will run you down if you ever dare to E
him. If he ults you, always save your R to dodge his Q to stall time for your escape with E, since you can
very rarely win a duel vs him. HOWEVER, if you are even at like 20 min and you got both your items
(hydra, divine sunderer) you are very likely to win a duel vs him. It's all just about surviving lane, which is really
hard. Just abuse your better early and try to snowball off that, grasp is probably superior here.

Try to poke him for EVERY minion he walks up to. If you let him do whatever he wants the lane will be
really hard very soon. In the early game you should be up in cs by quite a lot and you should get a
lead from that. Lane becomes very hard at lvl9 though since if you do 1 mistake he will just run you
down and you can't really fight back if you're not ahead from early. In lategame he wont really be able
to touch you since you got your E + W slow + Q ms. Just chunk him down with Q2

Play safe early and poke him with Q and W with the help of your passive. You should very rarely E onto
him since if you're too far up he will run you down most of the times. In general a pretty simple matchup
since he cant really touch you unless you walk up too far. Play fairly safe until you have your core items
and almost always save your E to get out of his range once he walks on you.

Same as Malphite, insane base dmg and not really killable. Rush Divine sunderer and you should deal some serious
dmg tho. You can E his pillar as well. Save R to dodge his R. Once you have 1-2 items it's kinda free, only issue is
that if the Ornn is good he can punish you a bit in lane and poke you.

Let him push into you early since you cant really afford to get chunked by his Q early (except if you have
second wind + dorans shield). You HARD outscale him at 1 or 2 items, only issue is the early game but
if you survive that its freelo.

You basically dont have an E button in this matchup. Trade with Q2 and W and just try to farm up in lane.
As every other tank matchup you destroy her at 1 or 2 items by just abusing Q2. Don't stay close to walls
to avoid losing 50% of your hp from her combo while shes building full tank.

Doran shield start and try to not get too poked early lvls, you hard win fights past lvl6 if
you manage to land your E on her. Dorans blade works too but its high risk high reward since you have higher kill
pressure, either way you outscale her pretty quickly and she should die when you have trinity and land your E on her.

Renekton matchup is very hard if he gets ahead in lane, usually its just short trades with q and
poking with w. Almost always save ur E until he E's onto you. His empowered W destroys ur shield so
you need to play around that as well, for sure one of the hardest matchups. You can also do short trades with E > Q2
> W > Run. But you need boots and some levels in Q to make sure he cant E onto you after that.

All you need to do here is get boneplating in runes and play safe first 2 levels, then you should
completely negate all his damage with passive and boneplating. Do short trades with Q-Q, W etc
Play with respect when he has 3-4 stacks. Honestly might be worth to go bramble vest here, I haven't tried it but
doesnt sound to bad. It delays your powerspikes a bit though, Try at own risk.

Skillmatchup, start dorans blade and just fight her lvl1 with your Q + boneplating + passive. You should
win straight up and can look for a kill lvl2. If it doesnt work just keep trading whenever your passive is
up. Respect her cds and abuse her when they are down. Tip: Use the E similar to how you would vs
Gnar, E onto wall and let her use her shield dash then dash onto her.

It's really even
here but I'd
say yes

Annoying matchup but still pretty easy. Go in with E whenever your passive is up and just spam trade
with him, you should slowly but surely chunk him down. Care for his lvl6 because that's when he has
kill potential on you.

This matchup is so insanely free, go pta and just go ham lvl1 with E and repeat at lvl2 when
you have Q, first blood 99% of the time. There is no way he should be able to contest
any minions past lvl3 if you manage the wave correctly and freeze it close to your turret.
Only way he has a chance in this lane is if the wave is frozen right to his turret.

Camille struggles hard early but once you get some items you just
run him down without any issues. He can never escape from you and you can always kite and play it very
slow by slowly chunking him with Q2. Lane phase is the only hard part in this matchup. At 2 items you
should destroy him if you play around your Q2 correctly. Use your R to dodge his W. Fleet footwork
makes your kiting way easier but conq deals more dmg. I prefer fleet in this matchup.

His extra range on autos whenever he Q's is quite annoying. Try to not let him get his blade to pass
through you because then you will just get destroyed. Rush tiamat and hardpush every wave and roam
to create pressure on the map. Save tp to match his ult or just say gl team and get those turret plates.
His base % dmg on Q is just absurd and makes it very hard to fight him, do short trades
only: E>AA>Q2>W

Constantly trade with him early and he wont be alive for long, your damage is way higher than his
through all stages of the game and as long as you dont chase him early it's very free. You destroy him on
sidelane at 2 items due to your Q2.

Can be difficult if Sion is good, after you get your 2 items it doesn't really matter though. I recommend dorans shield,
second wind and just farm up. You can do trades when your passive is up just be careful of his E into
fully charged Q

Skarner's current state (14.11) is just way too op for Camille to handle, his E cancels your E, he has infinite poke
and you have very little window to trade with him. It is playable but you'll have to hope that Skarner is bad or just
do your best to farm up. Most players are not aware that Skarner's E has priority over Camille E so you could
try to use it to your advantage. Honestly the easiest way of dealing with Skarner right now is to ban him, his lane
power is a bit too strong.

Just E onto him whenever you get the chance and chunk him until he dies. Only chance he has in lane
is to stall for 6 and then he might be able to run you down while healing everything. But since the ult
has a 2 min cd you have a huge window to abuse him. Buy executioner and destroy him

Annoying matchup but dorans shield/second wind denies most of his dmg. Poke him with W and E
onto him whenever your passive is up. If hes too far up you should be able to kill him. Wait his blind out
before Qing

She cant really jump on you since you will just outdamage her early on and your passive blocks all of her
dmg. 3 points into E then Q max, and just spam E and W on her and chunk her. At 6 she might be able
to all in you with R so play smart and dont waste your E. ninja tabi is really broken here.

If you do one single mistake he will run you down with ghost, if he doesnt have ghost the lane is free.
At 6 dont waste your E by poking if you think he can respond to it. Ninja tabi rush will make you survive
the lane but make it really hard to kill him since you lack damage. At 2 items just kite him and chunk with
Q2, try to dodge W and hes really useless. Lane could be hard because he hard outsustains you with Q
spam.

As long as he doesnt hit you with his E you're completely fine. Your E cancels his E which makes it pretty
easy to play around. If you have faker reactions you can easily dodge his R with your R as well. Later on
play it slow and chunk with Q2, dont let him free auto you with his machinegun.

Annoying lanebully and Vayne top players deserves no respect, go dorans shield if you want to be able to
farm or blade if you're feeling manly and feel that you can kill her early on. The gangplank route is fine
here (Comet 3 point into W) but I recommend just going 3 points into E and spamming it on her.
If you get on top of her shes forced to use her E and it has a longer cd than your E so abuse that small
window you have.

Try to bait his pool similar to Fioras parry. If you land E on him when his pool is not up, hes pretty much
dead. 3 points in E then Q max. Hexdrinker/other mr item is very effective. If you let him freeze and farm
close to his turret the lane is gonna be pretty hard.

If you have
magic resist
you win,
if not, he wins

Volibear is somewhat difficult to play against in lane, you can never E on him if his Q is up since
he can and he will oneshot you if he gets onto you. Play it slow and poke him with W and short trades
only. Try to always stay away from his range early on. ALMOST ALWAYS SAVE R TO DODGE HIS R.
Once you get sunderer hes kinda fucked. Hes strong later on as well but you should win
1v1s if you play it slow and chunk him with Q2. In lane if he uses Q and runs at you try to W him and
wait out his Q then E on him for a quick trade

he will win extended trades early because of his passive so the only
option is to do short trades with the help of your passive. He will try to 1v1 you lvl6 and can easily cancel
your E with his knockup if he knows how. Luckily you do outscale once you get trinity and hydra (as long
as he is not miles ahead of you). Short trades in lane is key in this matchup. Another trick is to E a wall and
hold it for a second or 2 because he will most likely use W preemptively. TIP: Lvl1: If he E's onto you
DO NOT AUTO INSTANTLY, if you auto him before he autos you after E'ing you will get a magic shield
from passive since his E deals magic damage. This only works in the first trade of the game.

This matchup heavily depends on how good the Yasuo is. Do the same as you do vs Gnar. E -> wait for
his dash -> Dash on him and chunk him. His tornado is pretty easy to dodge with your R and if he doesnt
have minions to dash to hes completely doomed in a 1v1. Do short trades only, he wins extended fights
99% of the time.

Matchup is easy until he summons his ult, that shit makes it almost impossible to duel him and ur
forced to just sit under turret and farm up. You should hard win early trades though with the help of your
passive and q-q. Play aggro early and safer once he gets his ult. Early lifesteal is pretty good here, later
on you do the usual by spamming Q2 and chunking him whenever you can. Save your E to not get
trapped and doomed.
